ConnectionDescription: Jira work items from the Aurora (AUR) project at zava-online.atlassian.net, including sprints, status and comments.

Properties.name: Key
Properties.description: Work item key, for example AUR-142.

Properties.name: Url
Properties.description: Link to the work item in Jira.

Properties.name: Title
Properties.description: Work item summary.

Properties.name: Description
Properties.description: Work item description.

Properties.name: Type
Properties.description: Work item type: Story, Task or Bug.

Properties.name: Status
Properties.description: Workflow status: To Do, In Progress or Done.

Properties.name: Priority
Properties.description: Priority: Highest, High, Medium or Low.

Properties.name: Assignee
Properties.description: Person the work item is assigned to.

Properties.name: Reporter
Properties.description: Person who reported the work item.

Properties.name: Labels
Properties.description: Labels on the work item.

Properties.name: Sprint
Properties.description: Sprint the work item is planned in.

Properties.name: SprintGoal
Properties.description: Goal of the sprint the work item is planned in.

Properties.name: SprintDates
Properties.description: Start and end dates of the sprint.

Properties.name: OriginalEstimateHours
Properties.description: Original estimate in hours.

Properties.name: Comments
Properties.description: Comments on the work item, oldest first, as 'date - author: text'.

Properties.name: LinkedItems
Properties.description: Linked work items, as 'relationship KEY'.

Properties.name: Project
Properties.description: Jira project.

Properties.name: ProjectUrl
Properties.description: Link to the Jira project.

Properties.name: CreatedAt
Properties.description: When the work item was created.

Properties.name: UpdatedAt
Properties.description: When the work item was last updated.

Properties.name: ResolvedAt
Properties.description: When the work item was resolved.

properties.Title: Telemetry gaps on Lakeshore Retail pilot hubs after firmware 4.2
properties.Description:
Some Lakeshore Retail pilot hubs on firmware 4.2 drop telemetry for up to 20 minutes after a store's nightly network restart.

**Acceptance criteria**

- No telemetry gap longer than one heartbeat interval after a network restart.

2026-10-28 - Triin Lepp: 4.2.1 is rolled out to all pilot hubs. Telemetry gaps are gone after last night's restart. Resolving.

properties.Title: Aurora hubs remain offline after reconnect
properties.Description:
Lakeshore Retail pilot hubs remain Offline in the dashboard after a successful network reconnect. Telemetry resumes, but staff restart working devices because the visible state is stale. Pilot expansion is November 23.

**Acceptance criteria**

- Reconnected pilot devices show Online on the active service.
- Automated new-service reconnect coverage.
- No regression in existing reconnect behaviour.
Comments: 2026-10-26 - Triin Lepp: I have started working on the fix.

2026-10-29 - Triin Lepp: Legacy-path fix is in review. Platform review asked for the same correction on the event-driven status service, because the pilot stores move to it at the November 20 cutover. That work depends on the reconnect-state design decision, which is still waiting for platform sign-off. Flagging this as at risk. I can't give a date until the design is approved.
2026-10-29 - Kerry Allen: Only Sprint 24 item tied to the November 23 pilot expansion that isn't on track. Keeping it at the top of Thursday's sprint check-in.
